definitions.gloss: row of cherry trees, cherry tree-lined road
definitions.explanation: A road or path lined with cherry blossom trees on one or both sides. A common and beloved sight in Japan, especially during spring when the trees are in full bloom.

examples.japanese: {桜並木|さくらなみき}を{散歩|さんぽ}する。
examples.english: To take a walk along the row of cherry trees.

examples.japanese: この{通|とお}りの{桜並木|さくらなみき}は{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: The cherry tree-lined avenue on this street is famous.

examples.japanese: {満開|まんかい}の{桜並木|さくらなみき}の{下|した}を{歩|ある}くと、{花|はな}びらが{雪|ゆき}のように{舞|ま}い{落|お}ちてくる。
examples.english: Walking under a row of cherry trees in full bloom, the petals flutter down like snow.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{桜並木|さくらなみき} is one of the most iconic springtime sights in Japan. Many rivers, parks, and streets are lined with cherry trees, and these locations become popular spots for {花見|はなみ} (cherry blossom viewing) in spring.

Famous {桜並木|さくらなみき} locations include the {目黒川|めぐろがわ} in Tokyo and {哲学|てつがく}の{道|みち} in Kyoto.

ETYMOLOGY:
{桜|さくら} (cherry blossom) + {並木|なみき} (row of trees along a road).
